title: Implement multi-head latent attention (MLA)
prompt: Implement the compressed-KV core of multi-head latent attention. Latent cache is (B,S,R), per-head key/value up-projections are (H,R,D)/(H,R,Dv), and Q is (B,H,L,D). This variant omits the separate RoPE branch.
chapter_title: Attention mechanisms: causal, cross, multi-head, and efficient attention

resources.title: DeepSeek-V3 Explained 1: Multi-head Latent Attention
resources.why: Builds MLA from the KV-cache problem, then low-rank compression, then decoupled RoPE.

resources.title: Three Interpretations of DeepSeek V2's Multi-headed Latent Attention Layer
resources.why: Reads MLA as low-rank compression and as a generalisation of GQA to check the idea from a second angle.
